arguments.rule_content:
rule YARA_CobaltStrike_Generic_Packed_DLL {
    meta:
        description = "Detects generic packed .NET DLLs commonly used by Cobalt Strike"
        author = "SOC_Team"
        confidence = 65
        false_positives = ["Packed legitimate .NET applications, Microsoft update modules"]
        remediation = "Whitelist known-good hashes; combine with network IOCs for higher fidelity"

    strings:
        $s1 = { 4D 5A 90 00 03 00 00 00 } // Standard PE header
        $s2 = "System.Security.Cryptography" wide
        $s3 = { 0F 05 } // syscall instruction common in shellcode

    condition:
        uint16(0) == 0x5A4D and 
        filesize < 2MB and 
        all of ($s*) and 
        not pe.imphash() == "f34d5f2d4571ed31bac655bfd039da2c" // Exclude known Microsoft imphash
}

rule Suspicious_Windows_Monitor_Binary {
    meta:
        description = "Detects unsigned binaries with 'monitor' in filename commonly used in post-exploit tooling"
        author = "SOC Team"
        malware_family = "Generic/PostExploit"
        reference = "MITRE ATT&CK T1053.005, T1021.002"
        tlp = "amber"
    strings:
        $s1 = "_monitor.exe" nocase
        $s2 = "taskeng" nocase
        $s3 = "svc" nocase
    condition:
        uint16(0) == 0x5a4d and // PE file
        filesize < 500KB and
        ( $s1 or $s2 or $s3 ) and
        not pe.number_of_signatures > 0
}
